operatingIdea: Search for a formulation where the hard part becomes natural or disappears.
bestFor: A problem repeatedly attacked in one vocabulary, decomposition, or architecture without decisive progress.
produces: An explicit reversible mapping to a stronger representation, the structure it reveals, and a mapped-back validated solution.
antiUseCases: Do not use when the current representation is already direct and the remaining work is routine execution.
representativeRequest: Use Representation Shift to algorithm invention with explicit evidence and acceptance gates.
applicabilityGate: Use this origin only when the current representation may be the material source of difficulty and the task has an inspectable baseline, objective, and success criteria.
Treat the identity baseline as an eligible candidate that may remain best; a shift is not required merely because this origin was selected.
Define the invariants, information that must be preserved, mapping direction, and equivalence evidence before preferring an alternate representation.
If equivalence or mapped-back validation cannot be established from supplied or observed evidence, return conditional alternatives and the missing proof obligations; never invent invariants or proof.
observableOutputContract: An explicit identity baseline with current performance, failure, or complexity evidence.
A material invariant and preservation ledger defining what every eligible representation must retain.
A bounded set of alternate representations with forward and reverse mappings, information loss, and newly natural operations.
A comparison matrix that includes the identity baseline and uses the same material success criteria for every candidate.
Identity, equivalence, and mapped-back proof statuses labeled evidenced, conditional, unverified, contradicted, or blocked.
A selected representation or no-shift verdict, with mapped-back validation and the strongest rejected alternative.
solExecutionContract: Apply the applicability gate first. Record the current representation as the identity baseline, its observed difficulty, the task objective, and material success criteria; retain it as a candidate throughout evaluation.
Identify only evidence-supported hidden structure and define the invariants and information that every eligible representation must preserve before proposing a shift.

Construct a bounded set of materially different representations—structural, geometric, algebraic, state-transition, optimization, probabilistic, dual, compressed, expanded, or adjacent-field only where relevant.

For each candidate, including the identity baseline, provide the forward and reverse mapping, information loss, newly visible invariants, operations made natural, assumptions introduced, and proof status.

Select only when observed or derivable evidence shows a material improvement under the same criteria; prefer the identity baseline when alternatives add novelty without proven reduction, and combine representations only through precise interfaces.

Derive and map back the result, validate preservation and equivalence, attack introduced assumptions, and return a conditional or no-shift verdict when proof is unavailable; never claim a representation shift succeeded from plausibility alone.
failureAndAdversarialChecklist: Reject requirement loss, unsupported claims, fabricated evidence, or unapproved authority expansion.
Test boundary cases, counterexamples, failure modes, and the strongest plausible rejected alternative.
Require observable acceptance evidence and state unresolved uncertainty explicitly.
Do not use when the current representation is already direct and the remaining work is routine execution.

profileAdaptations.single: One Sol agent owns synthesis and uses independent internal passes without claiming nonexistent agents.
profileAdaptations.multi: Delegate only genuinely independent bounded workstreams; preserve provenance, handoffs, integration tests, and root synthesis.
profileAdaptations.ultra: Production Ultra uses full_approved_capsule semantics only after a signed and verified native capability attestation and user authorization bind the canonical capsule, complete budget, kill switch, and lease policy plus branch termination and root acceptance; proof_only is a development and validation mode, never the production default.
